created_after.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Keeps reports created at or after this time.

include_unlisted.description: Include reports kept out of the shared inbox. A report is kept out when the scout that authored it turned off its `inbox` output destination. Defaults to false.

limit.description: The most results to return, best match first.

query.description: What to look for: natural language, such as a description of the issue, or an exact string, such as an error message or an entity name.

search_mode.description:
`hybrid` merges the keyword and semantic rankings. `semantic` ranks by meaning only, and returns 503 when the semantic search fails. `keyword` requires every query word in the title or the summary. Words such as `a` or `is` are too short to look up, so the keyword search leaves them out.

* `hybrid` - Hybrid
* `semantic` - Semantic
* `keyword` - Keyword

status.description: Comma-separated statuses to include. Valid values: potential, candidate, in_progress, pending_input, ready, monitoring, resolved, failed, suppressed. Defaults to every status, dismissed reports included.
